A <br> inside an inline code span splits the span and emits a hard break

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>X <code>A<br>B<br>C</code></p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
